I only went and met him. He came out from a room, hand shaked with me and later hugged me. I hold his right by my left and hand shaked again. My hand become bright. Please provide meaning of this dream. Question: Dear Shk, AA, In a dream I am going with my family to a paticular place to see Hazrat Issa (ASW). I only went and met him. Answer ID: 12363 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 971/736=H/1430) Ma-ShaAllah, it is nice dream. Study repeatedly the commentary of Surah Al-Anbiya in Maariful Quran (by Hadhrat Maulana Mufti Muhammad Shafi? sb) you will get much benefit in-shaAllah.
